# A page that fetches from another origin

A hyperlink to [a standards document](https://docs.ogc.org/is/19-086r6/19-086r6.html)
is allowed and must not be reported: the reader chooses to follow it.

<img src="https://example.invalid/a-picture.png" alt="a picture from somewhere else">
